title: Moses my servant is dead
english: On what is written: [[Moses my servant is dead >> Bible:Joshua 1:2]]. We must recount Moses’ death; unless we understand how Moses dies, we cannot see how Jesus reigns. If you look on Jerusalem overthrown, the altar abandoned, nowhere sacrifices or offerings or drink-offerings, nowhere priests or Levites — when you see all this cease, say: [[Moses the servant of God is dead >> Bible:Joshua 1:2]]. But when you see the nations enter faith, churches raised, altars consecrated by [[Christ’s precious blood >> Bible:1 Peter 1:19]], priests ministering the word of God by the Spirit’s grace — then say that Jesus has taken the principate after Moses: not Jesus son of Nun, but Jesus the Son of God. When you see that [[our Passover, Christ, has been sacrificed >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:7]] and we eat [[unleavened bread of sincerity and truth >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:8]]; when you see the church’s fruits [[thirtyfold, sixtyfold, a hundredfold >> Bible:Matthew 13:23]] — widows, virgins, martyrs; when you see Israel’s seed multiplied from those [[born not of blood nor of the will of flesh, but of God >> Bible:John 1:13]]; when you see God’s people keeping a sabbath rest not by idle withdrawal from common life but by rest from the work of sin — then say: Moses is dead, and Jesus the Son of God holds the principate. In a certain booklet outside the canon the figure is drawn of two Moseses — one alive in spirit, one dead in body. The empty letter of the law is Moses dead in the body; if you can [[remove the veil >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:16]] and understand that [[the law is spiritual >> Bible:Romans 7:14]], that is Moses alive in the spirit.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.

title: Jesus minister under the law
english: [[The Lord said to Jesus son of Nun, Moses’ minister: Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I give you >> Bible:Joshua 1:1-2]]. How was our Lord Jesus, Son of God, Moses’ minister? Because [[when the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son, made of a woman, made under the law >> Bible:Galatians 4:4]] — by being made under the law he was made Moses’ minister. God bids them cross into a land not given by Moses but [[that I give you >> Bible:Joshua 1:2]]. Moses dead, God gives the land to the people through Jesus — the land of which the Lord says: [[Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth >> Bible:Matthew 5:5]].

title: Every place your feet ascend
english: [[Every place you ascend with the soles of your feet I will give you >> Bible:Joshua 1:3]]. What places do we ascend? The letter of the law lies on the ground; whoever follows only the letter never ascends. If you can rise from letter to spirit and from history to a higher understanding, then you have truly climbed the high place you will receive from God as inheritance. If in what is written you discern types and [[seek the things above, where Christ is seated at God’s right hand >> Bible:Colossians 3:1]], you will receive that place — for our Lord says: [[Where I am, there will my servant be also >> Bible:John 12:26]]. If by faith, life, purity, and virtue you reach Christ seated at God’s right hand, and with those [[feet Jesus washed >> Bible:John 13:5]] you tread that place, God will give it to you; then you become not only [[God’s heir but Christ’s fellow-heir >> Bible:Romans 8:17]].

title: Desert and Antilibanus
english: [[As I said to Moses: the desert and this Antilibanus as far as the great river, the river Euphrates >> Bible:Joshua 1:3-4]]. God subjected the desert to Jesus — the deserts of which the prophet says: [[Rejoice, O thirsting desert >> Bible:Isaiah 35:1]] and [[More are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband >> Bible:Isaiah 54:1]]. He did not say Lebanon but Antilibanus — “over-against Lebanon.” If you see that former people according to the flesh, Israel, who was the [[true olive >> Bible:Romans 11:24]], understand him as the true Lebanon; but when for unbelief [[the kingdom is taken from him and given to a nation producing its fruit >> Bible:Matthew 21:43]], perceive that incoming people as Antilibanus — [[the church of the living God >> Bible:1 Timothy 3:15]] gathered from the nations through Jesus Christ our Lord, [[to whom be glory and dominion forever. Amen >> Bible:1 Peter 5:11]].
